title: Snapshot work sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,t\in\mathbb{N}$. For each machine state $\tau$, in order, take bits $3$ and $4$ of the cell block at time $t$, state $\tau$, and position $2T$; concatenate these pairs to form the snapshot work-source list.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$\ell$ is a finite list of bit sources
caveat: The supplied material does not define the cell-block index function or explain the role of the list $\ell$ in that indexing.
